page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This instance features 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, supported by 192.0 GB of RAM, which yields 4.8 GB of memory per core. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX-512 VNNI) and AES cryptography. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge demonstrates solid mid-range performance across compute and memory workloads. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1438.99, while the multi-core performance reaches 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached transfer rate of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. For decompression tasks, the instance achieves a multi-threaded bzip3 rate of 166.28 GB/sec. In database operations, the server handles 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 14249.04 in PassMark database operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge offers a balanced resource density, combining dedicated high-frequency physical cores with a moderate memory-to-core ratio. The absence of local storage and GPU hardware makes it a cost-effective option for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing. It is well-suited for applications such as web serving, multi-threaded decompression, database operations, and moderate language model inference, where its 12 Gbps network baseline and dedicated compute resources can be fully utilized.
